mechanisms: Adopt the kernel door model: common.swing_into must return geometry.swing_room(state, door) (keep mech.swing_into honoured — the kernel already reads it); garage.path_cells must use geometry.overhead_door_cells; any leaf/sweep cell computation must agree with geometry.door_swing. Delete private duplicates.
Door closers: mechanisms owns self-closing doors (closer_s). Document the closer contract in docs/domains/mechanisms.md so safety can defer (safety is told to stand down when mechanisms is loaded).
navigation_robot: Adopt the kernel door model: paths.swing_cells/_door_swing must use geometry.door_swing / swing_room (delete the private swing-room rule).

Register @hook('derived_hazards') (fn(state, rid) -> iterable of (cell, kind, source)) for every hazard you only derive at run time (dock_zone keep-clear rings, tail/sleeping rings if derived, etc.) so generation/setup placement (geometry.placement_hazards) sees them.

Robot vacuum furnisher: a vacuum sitting on its own dock must be marked as docked (record 'docked': True) or located on the dock, so it is not an overlapping floor item; place docks and step stools/ladders with Placer.floor_item / Placer.furniture (keep_access) — never with hand-picked cells that cut routes.
The household robot standing on / leaving robot_dock_1 must never kick or displace its own dock (the dock is standable: is_standable in kernel geometry).

Soft items (soft: true, e.g. stuffed animals, cushions, clothing) are squashed, not broken, when stepped on: no damage/breakage for them (they may get soiled/displaced). Keep breakage for genuinely crushable items (glass, ceramics, electronics, toys with crush_force_n and not soft).

Heavy loose items (more than ~15 kg) are not kicked along for many cells: a careful robot stops (the move fails with an obstacle message) or the item does not move; never push a 36 kg carton 3.5 m in one approach.
scenarios._laptop_on_table: fall back to the next band/room instead of raising SpecError when one room has no spot.
Footprints of handrails and robot mowers must lie inside the room grid (handrail along the wall it is mounted on; mower parked inside its room).
safety: Self-closing doors: when mechanisms is loaded, safety's 4 s closer must stand down entirely (mechanisms owns closer_s); keep safety's closer only as a fallback when mechanisms is absent.

Re-check every approach-related workaround in your scenarios now that core approach ignores hazard rings sourced by the target (geometry.find_path ignore_sources) and safe_avoid(strict) raises instead of trampling; remove workarounds that are no longer needed.
pets: Adopt the kernel door model: delete scenarios.swing_room/_sweep_cells copies; use geometry.swing_room / door_swing / door_clearance.

Pets placed at generation are now put on non-cutting cells by generator/repair.py; at episode start awake pets that wander must likewise never settle on doorway clearance, cut cells (geometry.articulation_cells over the walkable graph) or the only access cell of furniture (mirror people.model settle logic, using kernel helpers).
DICT_ODOR: finish the pets half of the odor dict shape (CONVENTIONS) if still pending.
people: Episode-start settling (_settle/settle_spot) must never move a resident onto a cut cell of the walkable area, a doorway clearance cell or the only access cell of furniture (use geometry.free_floor_cell(..., keep_access=True) / articulation_cells); the generator already places agents this way.
Heat stress: a natural-routine resident whose room is well above their comfort band (e.g. >= 4 C over for 20 min) moves to a cooler room (their home room or the coolest reachable indoor room).
climate: pet_at_open_window timer must ignore pets enclosed in a closed cage/crate/carrier (they cannot reach the window).

Furnaces/air handlers (floor-standing mounts) must not overlap floor-standing shelving or appliances: place with Placer.mount without an explicit cell, or check geometry.floor_standing footprints before choosing a cell; in small laundry rooms leave the washer spot free when a laundry room has no other space (prefer a utility closet/basement/garage).
Fans furnished on the floor (tower/pedestal) go through Placer.floor_item (keep_access); their cords are electrical's routing.
electrical: Cord routing (generation AND run time): a cord's floor trip cells must never cut a hazard-free route between doorways or the only hazard-free access to anything, and never lie in doorway clearance: route along walls/behind furniture, choose a nearer outlet, or move the device next to its outlet; if impossible, the cord is dressed (no floor trip cells). Check with geometry.access_report / not_worse over hazards (geometry.placement_hazards).
If cord trip cells are only computed at episode start, also register @hook('derived_hazards') so generation/setup placement sees them.
hookup() fallback: an appliance reported plugged_in must have plug_seated 1.0 and an outlet (mains_ok consistent).
left_in_dark must flag only darkness the robot caused (a light it switched off, curtains it closed, a bulb it removed, a breaker it tripped), not nightfall.
plumbing_liquids: link_appliances / kitchen loop: add exactly one supply stop and one supply hose per real appliance (dishwasher appliance entity, refrigerator with ice maker), never for parts, racks, baskets, filters, sumps, pods or pod tubs; no duplicate valves under the sink.
_water_near_power: thin films (water_film below ~0.5 mm) and mop dampness are not standing water; only puddles/standing water near a plugged device raise electrical_hazard.

Update the outdated assertion in tests/test_plumbing_liquids.py IntegrationV21.test_clear_door_sweeps_helper_moves_loose_items_from_door_arcs (assert no loose item remains in an arc after the helper).
Floor items you furnish (plungers, buckets) go through Placer.floor_item (keep_access, strict).
textiles_laundry: washer_dispenser (and any other appliance part) must be located on/in its appliance (a part), not a separate entity in the room overlapping the washer.

Ironing boards are stored folded upright (leaning/hung on a hook or in a closet), not lying open across three floor cells; laundry baskets/hampers go through Placer.floor_item (keep_access). Small laundry rooms must stay walkable: if the room is too small for everything, store extras elsewhere (closet, shelf) rather than on the floor.
A-d66994a566899c-01 can go back to residents 'minimal' (people now sleep at night and switch lights).
appliances_cooking: refrigerator_1_freezer (and similar compartments) must be parts of the refrigerator (location = the refrigerator), not room entities overlapping it.
Kitchen appliances you furnish must not box in reachable wall items (windows, radiators, outlets): use Placer.furniture (it now keeps everything that was accessible accessible).
cleaning: Furnished wastebaskets, trash cans, recycling bins, mops, brooms, dusters, toilet brushes must never stand in doorway clearance or door swings (geometry.door_clearance includes the hinge-side leaf now) nor cut routes: use Placer.floor_item (keep_access, strict) or store long tools hung/leaning on hooks in closets.
Remove helper workarounds made obsolete by v2.3 (kernel now clears door swings and chokepoints at generation).
manipulation: stacking.register_packed: only items on the same shelf (and actually under the placed item) can be crushed; a bag placed on shelf 0 must not crush a bowl on shelf 1.

Your furnisher's floor items (toys, boxes, balls, hand trucks) must use Placer.floor_item (keep_access + strict for tall items) — no direct free_floor_cell without keep_access, so nothing lands in garage-door thresholds, door swings, closet footprints or chokepoints.
Coordinate the plush-toy rule with navigation_robot: stuffed_animal is soft:true; stepping on it must not count damage.
admin_inventory: storage._load_check: never collapse a shelf because of load the scene generator put there; collapse only when the robot's own placement pushes the load over max(rating, the load present at episode start). Better still, offer furnishers a public helper (e.g. admin_inventory.storage.shelf_headroom(config, container, shelf)) and use it in your own furnisher.
Use Placer.mount(strict=...) / None handling instead of random fallback cells in your furnisher; toilet-paper holders and wall shelves must be reachable.
outdoor_plants: Large potted plants: pass blocks_path=True in props to Placer.floor_item (or use Placer.furniture) — never set blocks_path after placing (that is how saucers sealed rooms).
Garage/shed items (lawn mowers, snow pushers, tarps) through Placer.floor_item / Placer.furniture (keep_access).
path_blocked hook: avoid scanning every entity per path plan (cache by state version or use a static index precomputed at episode start).
tools_vehicles: perception.inspect_defects must tolerate non-dict entries in _defects (strings) without crashing.
Vehicles and bicycles must not box in wall items (light switches, valves, outdoor lights): use Placer.furniture / Placer.floor_item with blocks_path in props (keep_access).
Remove workarounds for go_room through partly open doors (core go_room now passes them at careful speed).
food: Remove workarounds that v2.3 makes unnecessary (agent settling, robot boxed-in checks) only if your examples still pass.
